title: Add dormant encoder backend config key
summary: Add a dormant global EncoderBackend config key that round-trips through PowerShell/Python schemas and feeds only the encoder capability diagnostic.
reason: Phase 6 needs an explicit backend-preference key before descriptor-backed hardware activation, while preserving current VideoCodec-driven encode behavior until hardware/HDR validation is complete.
behavior_before: Encoder backend preference was implicit. The capability dump always used backend auto, and no EncoderBackend key existed in defaults, schemas, metadata, option validation, or generated config contracts.
behavior_after: EncoderBackend defaults to auto, accepts auto/nvenc/qsv/amf/cpu, is global-only metadata, appears in PowerShell and Python config schemas, and is passed to -DumpEncoderCapabilitiesPath. Normal encode selection still follows VideoCodec and dormant hardware families remain inactive.
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_config_keys tests.python.desktop.test_service_config_option_policy tests.python.core.contract.test_config_contract tests.python.desktop.test_app_config_contract tests.python.desktop.test_metadata_contract tests.python.desktop.test_contracts tests.webview.test_webview_handbrake_settings_ui -q - passed, 110 tests
rollback_plan: Remove EncoderBackend from defaults, schemas, metadata, option validation, and config-key order; change the capability dump diagnostic back to backend auto; regenerate config schema and summaries; rerun config registry, runtime config, contract, WebView, and change-packet validation.
